project_type: TypeScript monorepo: React+Vite frontend game (@ddm/frontend), @ddm/shared pure logic, @ddm/backend Lambdas, infra CDK. This task touches ONLY packages/frontend + README files.
build_system: npm workspaces. Root `npm run build` = build shared -> backend -> frontend (tsc && vite build) -> infra. PATH may need: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"
test_framework: node:test with --experimental-strip-types (NO JSX in test files, pure helpers only). Shared: `npm test` (node:test). Frontend: `npm test -w @ddm/frontend` runs `node --experimental-strip-types --test src/game-ui.test.ts`.
verification_instructions: 1) `npm run build` from root (tsc typechecks frontend + vite build). 2) `npm test` (shared, baseline 152). 3) `npm test -w @ddm/frontend` (baseline 123 - new pure sound-helper tests must add to this and pass). Pure helpers must stay DOM/React-free so game-ui.test.ts can import them under node:test. The sound ENGINE (AudioContext/OscillatorNode) is browser-only and NOT unit-tested; document that.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. Vite produces packages/frontend/dist at build (not committed).
setup_instructions: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"; `npm install` already done (node_modules present). Network OPEN_INTERNET but NO new runtime deps needed (Web Audio is a browser API).
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET. No new runtime dependencies allowed. No headless browser/jsdom in tests - only pure TS helpers are unit-testable; AudioContext + DOM cannot be unit-tested here. Keep JA strings byte-identical for existing i18n keys.
contribution_requirements: Branch off main as feat/sound-and-settings. Do NOT push or open PR (orchestrator does that). Do NOT touch backup/previous-main. Well-separated commits. JA/EN parity for every new i18n string. Autoplay policy MUST be honored (no audio before first user gesture).
key_patterns: Accessible dialog pattern (REUSE): ZukanModal.tsx + App.tsx reset alertdialog + BattlePanel low-HP confirm all do: role=dialog/alertdialog + aria-modal=true + aria-label, focus moved into dialog on mount (useEffect ref.focus()), Escape closes, Tab/Shift+Tab focus trap via querySelectorAll of focusables, focus restored to trigger by PARENT via a triggerRef. i18n: i18n.ts JA_MESSAGES is source of truth for MessageKey; EN_MESSAGES is Record<MessageKey,string> (missing key = compile error) - add BOTH ja+en. localStorage helpers (REUSE pattern): guarded try/catch, `typeof localStorage === 'undefined'` check, keys namespaced `ddm.*` (ddm.lang, ddm.onboarded, ddm.pets, ddm.zukan, ddm.chat.<id>). Event→config pure-helper pattern: ui-helpers.ts CARE_EFFECTS Record<CareAction,CareEffect> + careEffect(action) accessor is the exact model to mirror for event→sound config. Pure helpers live in ui-helpers.ts and are unit-tested in game-ui.test.ts (import list at top). Reduced-motion: 10 `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` blocks in styles.css each set animation/transition:none on specific selectors.
